preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must start with a '#' character.
The input string must be exactly 7 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF' for c in hex_string[1:])
preconditions.description: The characters after the '#' must be valid hexadecimal digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be a dictionary.
The dictionary must contain exactly the keys 'r', 'g', and 'b'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in return_value.values())
postconditions.description: The values of 'r', 'g', and 'b' must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= value <= 255 for value in return_value.values())
postconditions.description: The values of 'r', 'g', and 'b' must be between 0 and 255 inclusive.
The value of 'r' must be the integer value of the first two hexadecimal digits after the '#'.
The value of 'g' must be the integer value of the middle two hexadecimal digits after the '#'.
The value of 'b' must be the integer value of the last two hexadecimal digits after the '#'.
